node.title: Re: Fetch URL Contents to File Handle
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I need to download a very large zipfile containing thousands of records, and print the first ten records ... Is there a way of downloading into a filehandle or pipe so that I don't have to download the entire large file?

A ZIP file's central directory is at the end of the file. Although you could get fancy with [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Range_requests|range requests], it might be easier to actually download the whole file. How big is "very large"? Update: Even though 10MB isn't that big for a daily download, it turns out to be much easier to [id://11117856|use the site's API].
